job: List what a plan or product includes, one line each with an icon.
purpose: Rows of an icon and text. Comfortable by default; data-size="sm" for dense cards. Excluded items stay in the list, muted, so plans compare line by line. Each row can carry a title and a description.
useWhen: A pricing card or plan lists what is included and what is not.
A product card or checklist-style summary needs scannable points.

avoidWhen.when: Items are ordered steps that someone checks off.
Rows are people, files or records with metadata.
Rows are label and value pairs.
Rows are settings with a control.

states.name: excluded
states.how: data-excluded on a row; muted, with a cross or dash icon

variants.useWhen: A hero list with room between rows.
Icons in the accent colour for the recommended plan.
A row that names its own leading icon.

parts.role: A row with a leading icon.
